review_description: Very good to deal with from the outset, kept me in the loop at all times, very professional installation, clean and tidy, polite at all times whilst on the job, we are very happy with the system knowing we have secure power into the future, I would highly recommend off grid energy australia to friends and family cheers Mick

Fantastic consultation with Thomas here in Rockhampton face to face not trying to compare 3 or so quotes over the phone like with other companies. Explained everything in detail about the whole system and process.That was Saturday 6th October and the installation date was Wednesday 11th October at 4pm the young team did the install as the team was still in the area and could fit me in.Wonderful friendly guys who came to do the job. Very efficient and would highly recommend this company to do any install.Heather from the administration side of the company was fantastic kept me up to date with times etc.I will be getting them to do a install at my son and daughter in laws place at Blackwater when they are able to fit it in.
The two suppliers you recommended both exhibited the very traits you warned against, cowboys overcharging.

It is very important to be well informed. I spent quite some time learning about solar systems and battery storage from sites like Solar Quotes. On most occasions I was better informed than the sales person as they struggled to "google" answers to my questions. Collecting data about my electricity consumption was vital in helping me decide the size of system and amount of battery capacity needed. I found there was very little difference between brands of solar panels so the quality of the workmanship, after sales support and battery storage specifications were my deciding factors.
